binding_moment: Before writing a fixer or builder brief, triaging review or audit findings, or reporting findings to Joe or Dell.

applicability.unfixed_exception: The fixer shows the finding is not a defect and writes the reason in the PR.

delivery.why: Deliver at agent briefs, findings-file writes, record-finding calls and PR creation or report edits; routine reads remain silent.

reachability.enforcement: ops/ci.sh gates class -> ops/findings-coverage-gate.py -> GitHub required ops/ci.sh --strict
reachability.scope_limit: CI enforces reports that declare Findings-source. Undeclared or non-file findings and semantic fix or non-defect truth remain judgment obligations; route delivery reminds the fixer.

source.findings: Array of objects with unique nonempty id strings across sources; severity is never filtered.

report: Finding: <id> | fixed | <fix evidence> OR Finding: <id> | not_a_defect | <reason>
input_contract.brief: Same source and total; use planned with the fix action in place of fixed. A report cannot use planned.

reason: Joe approved verbatim Approve on 2026-10-05. Admit only after the merged control catalog migration is applied and the exact merged CI/brief checks and live delivery pass; manifest completeness is mechanical, semantic defect and fix judgments remain with the reviewer.
